en.text: Press 1, 2, 3, or 4 to use your hero's abilities.
Hold mouse 2 to zoom in with your weapon.
Press space to jump.
Hold space when near a ledge to mantle up.
Press Q to use your melee attack up close.
Press mouse 1 to shoot. Gun damage falls off at longer ranges.
Hold space to get on the Shadowline. You can jump off by pressing space.
Spend ability points to upgrade your abilities. Abilities have three upgrade tiers, and you upgrade them in order.
Destroying an enemy objective earns everyone on your team ability points. You also earn ability points as you accumulate souls.
Get souls by killing troopers and players. You can also get souls by killing neutrals located throughout the map. Souls are shared among allies nearby.
Spend souls to buy items.
When you land a killing blow, extra souls pop out. You can secure these souls by shooting the green orb containing them or letting them float away.
When you have ability points or souls to spend, go back to base to shop and heal. There's also a shop next to each Guardian, available until the Guardian is destroyed.
Enemy soul orbs are orange, and enemies will get them if they float away or if they shoot them. You can shoot these orange orbs first to steal them.
While airborne, dash to perform an air dash.
While airbone, dash to perform an appropriately named airdash.
While moving, press left shift to dash.
Combine a dash and a well-timed jump to perform a dash jump.
Combine a dash and a well-timed jump to perform, you guessed it, a dash jump.
Combine a dash and a well-timed jump to perform, surpise surprise, a dash jump.
Press space at the top of a jump to double jump. Special moves like double jump use your stamina bar, located next to your reticle.
Press space at the top of a jump to double jump. Special moves like double jump, dash, etc whathaveyou use your stamina bar, located next to your reticle.
Press F to parry an enemy's melee attack. They'll be stunned and will receive increased melee damage.
Hold left control to slide while moving down a ramp or moving at high speed.
There's a shrine at the back of each team's base. Destroying the enemy shine wins the game.
There's a shrine at the back of each team's base. Destroying the enemy shrine completes the ritual and wins the game.
Guardians are the first line of defense in each lane. Their attacks are very powerful, so it's best to push in on them with your troops.
There are four lanes, each with a shadow line that players can ride to move quickly.
Troopers periodically spawn in the base and then run down a lane, fighting any enemies they encounter.
Walkers lie deeper in the lanes and have an arsenal of defensive moves.
Shadowline is a 6v6 strategic shooter where gunplay, fast-paced movement, tower progression, and unique heroes collide.
